title: Kiritani Haruka — Perfect Premonition〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
This cafe seems nice.
Thanks for showing me this place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like it.
They even have delicious parfaits on top of a great drink menu.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! Here were have our yummy parfait menu! I recommend the seasonal fruit parfait that's only going to be available for a limited time!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hehe. You look adorable in your uniform, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, if that's everything, we'll start working on your order right away!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Mai, congratulations again on closing out your show.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You really caught me by surprise when you said that you'd be stopping by again to catch our closer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was initially planning on seeing it in secret, but I decided to let you know just in case anyone realized it was me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But your final performance was incredible. I even got to see you do something a little different compared to when we came as a group.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Oh, you mean the middle scene?
My senior ad-libbed that part.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, they ad-libbed that?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Yeah! They winked their signal at me, but I was like, “No, wait...!”

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Speaking of which... How'd that thing you mentioned before go? Everything better now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah. I appreciate your concern.
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I see...
So that's what happened.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Still, that's so awful.
Why would anyone say it's stolen without any proof...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I really wanted to tell you earlier when we all went to see your show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I decided not to since I had a feeling you'd see right through me if I tried fibbing by saying, “There's nothing wrong...”

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'm actually really glad that you let me know that something was going on and didn't try to hide it from me.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
It's just like old times.
You trusted me with this sort of information.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course I trust you.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I want to keep being there for my fans by being the “idol” I want to be...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: That's probably the reason why I'm standing here right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you work harder than anyone I know and take being an idol, your dream, very seriously...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You saying that just makes me want to try even harder, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Oh, but I promise not to push myself so hard again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you won't.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The past can't be fixed, so our wounds from back then won't heal easily...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But let's keep doing our best without overdoing it.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. Haruka, as earnest as ever.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But you're right. Let's do our best without overdoing it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for your patience!
Here's your special fruit parfait and strawberry parfait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, these look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Yeah, they do. Also, they're huge!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
That's the best part about this place! The real deal's always better than what you see in the picture!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we also have small plates available if you want to share. Would you like some?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Still... Are you sure we can finish these?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The whipped cream they use here's nice and light, so it shouldn't give us too much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Well, it won't give you much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Nothing. Hehe.
